findings.element: Wizard step 2 — clear-X button inside every filter trigger (.custom-select-trigger), e.g. Kantone and TU's
findings.finding: Once a filter holds a value the clear-X sits at the horizontal centre of the trigger, so clicking the middle of the control — the natural way to reopen it — silently wipes the selection instead of opening the panel.
findings.user_impact: A user trying to add to or review a filter destroys the value they already chose, gets no message saying so, and can run the evaluation on filters they believe are still set.
findings.suggested_fix: Pin the clear-X to the right edge of the trigger (own flex slot, not the space-between middle child), shrink its hit area to the icon, and confirm or announce the clear with an undo.

evidence.action: Measured the trigger with elementFromPoint (trigger 542px wide, centre x=789, clear-X occupies x=769–789), then clicked the centre of the Kantone trigger holding ['AG'] and of the TU's trigger holding ['BLS']
evidence.observed: elementFromPoint(centre) returned 'canton-clear' / 'tu-clear'; Kantone went ['AG'] → [] with the label reverting to 'All cantons' and the panel not opening; TU's went ['BLS'] → []. No toast, warning or undo appeared.

findings.element: Scheduled reports → Edit action (wizard opened in edit mode)
findings.finding: Editing a saved schedule opens the wizard titled with that schedule's name but loads none of its configuration, and hides the schedule section entirely.
findings.user_impact: The user believes they are amending an existing schedule while actually looking at a blank default config, so saving replaces a working schedule with defaults, and the frequency they came to change cannot even be seen.
findings.suggested_fix: Hydrate the wizard from the stored schedule (period, TU, cantons, lines, frequency) on Edit, and keep the schedule section visible and editable in edit mode.

evidence.action: Clicked Edit on the scheduled report 'Fahrtausfälle DPM – Wöchentlich' and inspected the wizard state
evidence.observed: Title showed 'Fahrtausfälle DPM – Wöchentlich' with a 'Scheduled' badge, but state.selectedPeriod had reset to 'cur_month' and TU/cantons/lines were all empty; the schedule section was hidden so the frequency was neither shown nor changeable.

findings.element: Evaluations list — row action column on 'Fertig' rows of type Rohdaten Export, Linienanalyse DPM and Datenqualitätsindex
findings.finding: Ten of the nineteen finished evaluations have no Anzeigen button and no clickable row name, so a completed report of those types cannot be opened at all.
findings.user_impact: A user who waited for an evaluation to finish reaches a dead end — the list says the work is done but offers no way to see the result, and the only remaining row action is Delete.
findings.suggested_fix: Give every row with status 'Fertig' an open affordance (Anzeigen button plus a clickable row name), or state inline why a finished evaluation of that type cannot be opened.

evidence.action: Enumerated the 28 list rows and their action buttons, then attempted to open a finished Rohdaten Export row by clicking its name
evidence.observed: Only 9 of 28 rows carry an 'Anzeigen' button; 10 of the 19 'Fertig' rows have none. The row name has no onclick and cursor:auto, so the click did nothing.

findings.element: Wizard step 3 — Run Now button with the schedule box ticked
findings.finding: Committing with a schedule configured produces a confirmation that mentions only the immediate run, and the schedule never appears in Geplante Berichte.
findings.user_impact: The user has no way to tell whether the recurring schedule they just set up was saved or silently discarded, so they either lose the automation or set it up a second time.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the confirmation state both outcomes ('Started now · Weekly schedule saved, next run 03.09.2026') and add the new entry to Geplante Berichte immediately after commit.

evidence.action: Configured a schedule in step 3 (toggle ticked, frequency selected, 'Run on' block set), clicked Run Now, then opened Geplante Berichte
evidence.observed: Toast read 'Evaluation started — running now' with no mention of the schedule, the app returned to the evaluations list, and the new schedule was not present in Geplante Berichte.

findings.element: Wizard step 2 — Kantone filter panel (vs the five identical sibling panels)
findings.finding: Kantone is the only one of six visually identical filter panels that closes on the first pick, so multi-selecting cantons requires reopening the control while its siblings do not.
findings.user_impact: A user who has learned the multi-select rhythm from RPV, Verkehrsmittel, TU's, Linien and Haltestellen cannot add a second canton the same way, and the reopen attempt lands on the clear-X and wipes the first canton instead.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the Kantone panel open after a pick so all six multi-select filters commit identically, closing only on outside click or an explicit Done.

evidence.action: Picked one option in each of the six filter panels, then attempted a second pick in each without reopening; tried twice by mouse to add a second canton
evidence.observed: RPV, Verkehrsmittel, TU's, Linien and Haltestellen all stayed open and accepted the second pick (e.g. 'BLS' → 'BLS, CJ'); the Kantone panel closed on the first pick (second_interaction: false) and a second canton could not be added by mouse in two attempts.

gaps: Wizard step 3: the notify-by-email toggle and email input were never exercised (state map's not_exercised list), so whether the user gets any confirmation that a notification recipient was accepted is unknown.
Login: the 'Passwort vergessen?' link is onclick="return false" and was never exercised, so there is no recorded account-recovery path to judge.
Topbar nav (Startseite / Q.Reports / Fotoalbum / Q-Messungen) is inert and unexercised, so the surrounding navigation model — and whether the wizard is escapable via it — is unassessed.
No loading or in-progress state is recorded anywhere between clicking Run Now and the list reappearing; the map records only the resulting toast, so loading-state clarity could not be judged.

No error state was ever produced anywhere in the flow (login accepts empty fields, the reversed date range raises nothing), so the quality and recoverability of error messaging is entirely unassessed.
The empty state is recorded only for a no-match search on the evaluations list; the first-run empty state of the evaluations list and of Geplante Berichte was not reached.

Cascade between filters: the map records that picking cantons/TUs 'did not visibly narrow' the Linien list but does not record whether cascading is intended, so it is unclear whether a user selecting incompatible filters is left with a silently empty result set.

The reversed custom date range (20.08.2026 → 01.08.2026) was accepted and Next stayed enabled, but the resulting evaluation was not run, so what the user finally sees for an impossible period is unrecorded.

Delete on an In-Progress row is pointer-events:none with title still 'Delete'; no hover or click feedback was recorded, so whether the user gets any explanation at all could not be confirmed beyond the unchanged title.
